title: Brand Marketing Executive - 12 month FTC
description:
Think Specialist Recruitment are delighted to be working with a Global organisation based within the Watford area. This company are a market leader within their field, they have an exciting opportunity for a Degree educated candidate with 1-2 years experience, to join their Brand Marketing team. This position will be working closely with the Brand Marketing Managers, playing a key part in planning, delivering and executing brand plans for the business.
This person will need to have 1-2 years experience within Marketing, and due to the fact this company work within the office 4 days, this person will need to be local to the office.

Salary - £28,000 - £32,000 depending on experience
Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm - 4 days in and 1 day from home
Please note - this is an initial 12 month FTC

Some of the duties will include:
- Supporting annual brand plans and coordinating activity across multiple channels
- Helping lead SEO, eCRM and social activity, working with both internal teams and external agencies
- Developing and refining messaging across social, PR, SEO and campaign assets
- Supporting new product launches and working with Product, Trade and Digital teams on go-to-market plans
- Ensuring product and website content is accurate, engaging, optimised and focused on consumer benefits
- Briefing agencies, reviewing creative, coordinating feedback and keeping projects moving
- Ensuring communications consistently reflect brand positioning, tone of voice and visual identity
- Coordinating activity with internal and external partners to deliver a smooth customer experience
- Conducting brand, competitor, marketing and retail audits to identify trends, gaps and opportunities
- Supporting budgets, purchase orders, reporting and day-to-day project management

The suitable candidate:
- Degree Educated candidate
- 1-2 years experience within a marketing focused role
- Previous experience delivering marketing campaigns across multiple channels
- Strong communication skills on all levels both verbal and written
- Has the ability to multi-task and prioritise a busy workload
- Can build strong working relationships both internally and externally
- A good understanding of social media
- Must be local to Watford

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including: administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing and IT Helpdesk/IT support

title: Content and Social Media Executive
description:
Challenger brands will never succeed when they're just copying what the rest of the market does, regurgitating the same old proposition and making the same promises. For the new kid on the block to make an impact, they need to do something differently. The company we're partnering with on this exclusive role have done just that and managed to carve themselves (and own) a unique niche in a massively congested market. They've built their brand around a couple of key pillars - sustainability and great customer service - and have reached a stage of their development where they need someone dedicated to capturing and communicating the essence of their brand through social channels.

The Content and Social Media Executive is a newly created role with carte blanche to help push the firm's social engagement to the next level and make it an even stronger customer acquisition channel - along with the ongoing storytelling aspect. The company has nurtured an agile, energetic environment where good ideas are welcomed and people are encouraged to get on with making them happen - so for the right person, that means plenty to work with: an established and growing brand, interesting stories, passionate people and an audience that's ready to hear more from it.

The Role - Content & Social Media Executive

This is definitely not a role for someone who wants to be handed a completed content calendar and a folder marked "approved assets": you'll be expected to bring ideas with you, learn how to frame them in order to get buy-in across the business and then showcase their success. Working closely with the Head of Marketing and people across the business you'll help shape what the brand talks about, how it talks about it and increasingly have influence into where those conversations happen. You'll create social content, write copy, produce visuals, film and edit short-form video and uncover stories from around the business that deserve an audience. If you're confident presenting on screen then that's certainly another string to your bow that will be useful.

You'll need to be one of social media's biggest champions internally. You'll need the confidence and energy to get people across the business involved - maybe dragging Paul from accounts out to help you with a reel - and explain what makes good social content whilst persuading colleagues to share their stories, opinions, expertise and moments that can bring the brand to life.

Key Responsibilities - Content & Social Media Executive
- Generate original content ideas that support the brand, customer engagement and commercial objectives.
- Plan content calendars and campaigns across social media, website and digital channels.
- Champion social media throughout the organisation and encourage colleagues to get involved.
- Seek out stories, opinions and expertise from across the business and turn them into engaging content.
- Create visual content using Canva and other creative tools.
- Film, edit and produce short-form video including Reels, Shorts and TikTok-style content.
- Write social-first copy alongside blogs and other website content.
- Spot opportunities around trends, industry developments and seasonal events without feeling obliged to jump on every bandwagon with a hashtag attached.
- Help create B2 B content including guides, educational resources and thought leadership.
- Produce assets to support LinkedIn activity, partnerships and sales outreach.
- Create and adapt content for digital advertising across social, Google and other channels.
- Engage with customers and followers, responding to comments, messages and enquiries in a way that reflects the company's reputation for excellent customer service.
- Monitor performance and use the results to make the next piece of content better.
- Help build an engaged community around the brand, sustainability and renewable energy.

About You - Content & Social Media Executive

We're looking for someone with ideas. Lots of them. Good ones, bad ones, really awful ones - it doesn't matter. As long as there are some good ones. Or even better, great ones. You could be fresh out of university, or still relatively early in your marketing career, but you'll already be creating good content and you'll have a portfolio that shows us what you can do. You'll understand social media beyond simply knowing where the buttons are and you'll have a feel for what makes people stop, watch, read, comment or share and be able to apply that to the environment this business operates in.

You'll ideally bring:
- Experience creating engaging content for social media.
- Strong Canva skills and a good eye for visual communication.
- Experience filming and editing video.
- Excellent copywriting and written communication skills.
- Strong creative instincts and plenty of ideas.
- The confidence to champion social media internally.
- A good understanding of current platforms, trends and content formats.
- The energy to thrive in an agile, fast-moving environment.
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage several projects at once.
- A genuine interest in sustainability and environmental issues.

Experience with Meta, LinkedIn, Google Ads, photography, SEO or website content management would all be useful additions. Above everything else, you'll be curious, proactive and full of energy. You'll enjoy finding stories rather than waiting for them to land in your inbox and you'll be comfortable putting forward an idea, explaining why you think it'll work and then getting on with making it happen. You'll be joining a an amazing business with a strong story, an enviable reputation for customer service and ambitious plans for what comes next - and you'll have a pretty big say in how that story gets told.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: Watford Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 Permanent: Office-based Monday - Friday

CTR Select is recruiting on behalf of our client for a Marketing Executive to join their team. This is a varied, commercially focused role covering digital marketing, content creation, customer engagement and sales support.

A key focus will be increasing customer adoption and use of the company's B2 B digital ordering portal, alongside delivering campaigns that support sales growth and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop campaigns to increase customer adoption and usage of the digital ordering portal.
- Create targeted email and SMS campaigns to drive engagement and ordering frequency.
- Produce user guides, video tutorials, sales tools, pitch decks and product materials.
- Promote new digital services and portal features to existing customers.
- Create marketing materials for sales meetings, conferences and promotions.
- Manage social media content, blogs, newsletters and website updates.
- Build and distribute targeted email campaigns.
- Monitor website performance and support SEO activity.
- Track digital engagement, sales activity and campaign performance.
- Monitor competitor activity and identify marketing opportunities.
- Work closely with sales and commercial teams to support business growth.
- Maintain brand assets, templates and marketing materials.

About You

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a marketing role, preferably within a B2 B or commercial environment.
- Experience with email marketing, CMS and CRM systems such as Salesforce.
- Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design tools.
- Good understanding of digital marketing, social media and SEO.
- Strong Excel, organisational and analytical skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive, commercially aware and flexible approach.
- An understanding of AI tools and their application within marketing.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on, creative and commercially minded marketer looking for a varied role where they can make a real impact on customer engagement and business growth.

If this Marketing Executive role is of interest to you, please click apply or contact Marie Spratley in our Egham office.

title: Senior Brand Manager Mr Kipling All Year Round
description:
Mr Kipling is an iconic £220m RSV brand with ambitious plans for growth, built around a simple belief: bringing a little joy and putting the cherry on top of everyday life.

We are looking for a commercially sharp and ambitious Senior Brand Manager to help shape what comes next. This is a high-impact brand leadership opportunity where you will own significant areas of the portfolio, turn consumer and category insight into winning choices, and mobilise teams across the business to deliver them brilliantly.

This is not a role for someone who simply manages a plan. It is for someone who sees opportunities, creates momentum and makes things happen, from upstream innovation and brand strategy through to standout execution with UK retailers.

What you'll be doing?
- Own key areas of the Mr Kipling portfolio and deliver against commercial objectives.
- Turn consumer, shopper and market insights into winning growth plans.
- Lead innovation projects from concept through to launch and post-launch optimisation.
- Develop compelling brand activations across digital, social and retail channels.
- Partner with Sales, Category and Commercial teams to drive customer success.
- Coach and develop our Marketing Graduate whilst leading cross-functional project teams

What we need from you?
- FMCG brand marketing experience, ideally at Brand Manager or Senior Brand Manager level.
- Strong commercial acumen with experience managing budgets and delivering results.
- A passion for consumer insight, innovation and building brands people love.
- Excellent influencing and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to turn strategy into action.

What we offer you in return:
- Competitive salary and bonus
- Car allowance
- Up to 7.5% pension
- Private medical insurance and life assurance
- Hybrid working (50% home / 50% office or site)
- Sharesave scheme and the option to purchase additional holiday
- Extensive learning and development opportunities
- Access to a wide employee discount scheme
